subject: Human Body
title: The Colon's Job
description: A quick win: understand The Colon's Job.

hook.text: By the time food reaches the large intestine, 90% of nutrients are gone. What remains is mostly waste and water.

buildup.text: The colon is about 1.5 meters long and frames the abdomen like a picture frame.

discovery.text: Its primary job: absorb remaining water and compact waste into stool. It reclaims about 1.5 liters of water daily.

twist.text: Without the colon, dehydration would be constant. People who lose their colon need to drink far more fluids.

climax.text: The colon turns liquid waste into solid. It's a water recycling plant that keeps you hydrated.

punchline.text: The colon's real job is saving water, not making waste.
